about: The schedule's PR 14a (to-dos/gc-mode/mockups/schedule-pr14.md, calls 4 and 6; #5356, v2.5196): the portal's own checks before a trade's write, lifted word for word so the server's verbs and the portal's forms read the same rules. lateNoticeProblem appends to schedule/lateNotices.ts (the order of the refusals gc_trade_say_late raises), and crewCountProblem and portalCrewAsks to schedule/crewCounts.ts (portalCrewAsks reads portalLookAhead from main's portal.ts, no cycle). The spike re-exports all three from main since this follow-up, so each has one copy. Their tests are main's own (lateNotices.direct.test.ts, crewCounts.direct.test.ts); the prototype's that play its reducer stay on the spike, where they run against main's. Not in LIFTS: no shape moved.
